import collections, json, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path(r"D:\Dev\nemu")
output_path = root / "reports/P0-07/direction-v2/microsoft--Phi-4-mini-instruct.json"
config_path = root / "workers/model-adapter/probe/.cache/models/microsoft--Phi-4-mini-instruct/cfbefacb99257ffa30c83adab238a50856ac3083/generation_config.json"
payload = json.loads(output_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
samples = payload["samples"] if isinstance(payload, dict) else payload
config = json.loads(config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
eos_value = config["eos_token_id"]
eos_ids = {eos_value} if isinstance(eos_value, int) and not isinstance(eos_value, bool) else set(eos_value)
by_language = collections.defaultdict(list)
for sample in samples:
    by_language[sample["language"]].append(sample)
summary = {}
all_eos_occurrences = collections.Counter()
all_after = []
all_without_eos = []
for language in sorted(by_language):
    members = by_language[language]
    by_seed = collections.defaultdict(list)
    first_eos_counts = collections.Counter()
    samples_without_eos = []
    samples_after_first_eos = []
    eos_occurrences = collections.Counter()
    for sample in members:
        by_seed[sample["seed"]].append(sample)
        ids = sample["token_ids"]
        for token in ids:
            if token in eos_ids:
                eos_occurrences[token] += 1
                all_eos_occurrences[token] += 1
        first_position = next((i for i, token in enumerate(ids) if token in eos_ids), None)
        if first_position is None:
            samples_without_eos.append({"seed": sample["seed"], "coefficient": sample.get("coefficient")})
            all_without_eos.append({"language": language, "seed": sample["seed"], "coefficient": sample.get("coefficient")})
        else:
            first_eos_counts[ids[first_position]] += 1
            if first_position + 1 < len(ids):
                row = {
                    "language": language,
                    "seed": sample["seed"],
                    "coefficient": sample.get("coefficient"),
                    "first_eos_position": first_position,
                    "token_count_after_first_eos": len(ids) - first_position - 1,
                }
                samples_after_first_eos.append(row)
                all_after.append(row)
    different_pairs = 0
    identical_pairs = 0
    incomplete_pairs = []
    for seed in sorted(by_seed, key=lambda value: str(value)):
        pair = by_seed[seed]
        zero = [sample for sample in pair if sample.get("coefficient") == 0 or sample.get("coefficient") == 0.0]
        one = [sample for sample in pair if sample.get("coefficient") == 1 or sample.get("coefficient") == 1.0]
        if len(zero) != 1 or len(one) != 1:
            incomplete_pairs.append({
                "seed": seed,
                "coefficient_0_count": len(zero),
                "coefficient_1_count": len(one),
                "group_sample_count": len(pair),
            })
        elif zero[0]["token_ids"] == one[0]["token_ids"]:
            identical_pairs += 1
        else:
            different_pairs += 1
    summary[language] = {
        "sample_count": len(members),
        "distinct_seed_count": len(by_seed),
        "paired_seed_count": identical_pairs + different_pairs,
        "coefficient_0_1_token_ids_different_pairs": different_pairs,
        "coefficient_0_1_token_ids_identical_pairs": identical_pairs,
        "incomplete_or_duplicate_pairs": incomplete_pairs,
        "samples_with_first_eos": len(members) - len(samples_without_eos),
        "samples_without_eos": samples_without_eos,
        "first_eos_stop_counts_by_token_id": {str(k): v for k, v in sorted(first_eos_counts.items())},
        "all_eos_token_occurrence_counts": {str(k): v for k, v in sorted(eos_occurrences.items())},
        "samples_with_tokens_after_first_eos": samples_after_first_eos,
    }
print("SAMPLE_COUNT=" + str(len(samples)))
print("EOS_IDS=" + json.dumps(sorted(eos_ids), separators=(",", ":")))
print("ALL_EOS_TOKEN_OCCURRENCE_COUNTS=" + json.dumps({str(k): v for k, v in sorted(all_eos_occurrences.items())}, separators=(",", ":")))
print("PER_LANGUAGE_SUMMARY_JSON=" + json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":")))
print("SAMPLES_WITH_TOKENS_AFTER_FIRST_EOS_JSON=" + json.dumps(all_after, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":")))
print("SAMPLES_WITHOUT_EOS_JSON=" + json.dumps(all_without_eos, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":")))
